name: Password Protected Site and Store
author: Codenix

sections.description:
Want to make your WordPress site password protected? Need to create a protected WooCommerce store for select users or clients only? Our Password Protected Site and Store plugin is the ultimate all-in-one solution to restrict access and fully customize the experience – without touching any code.

Whether you’re building a staging site, client preview, private membership area, or exclusive product showcase – this plugin gives you complete control over who can access your WordPress site or WooCommerce store.

✅ Key Features
🔹 Password protect entire site, specific pages, or WooCommerce products
🔹 Set unique passwords for different sections – even individual products
🔹 Enable or disable password for logged-in administrators
🔹 Restrict access based on user roles (Admin, Editor, Subscriber, etc.)
🔹 Customize the password form – title, description, colors, fonts, and layout
🔹 Add your own logo or brand identity to the login form
🔹 Style the submit button with custom colors, borders, hover effects, and more
🔹 Fully customizable input field styles – from placeholder text to font and border
🔹 Set background images or colors for the protected screen
🔹 No coding required – beginner friendly, yet powerful for developers

🔒 Why Use This Plugin?
There are many reasons to protect your WordPress site or WooCommerce store:

  • Building a client site and need to restrict access?
  • Selling wholesale or invite-only products?
  • Running a private blog or online community?
  • Showcasing content to selected users only?

This plugin is the best way to create a secure, password protected environment on WordPress – with full control over access and design.

🎨 Designed for Customization
Unlike basic plugins, you’re not stuck with default styles. You can make the password page match your brand with:

  • Custom logo upload
  • Background color or image with opacity control
  • Font settings, field styling, and text alignment
  • Button customization – color, border, hover, font

Perfect for agencies, developers, and site owners who care about visual identity.

🔐 Protect Your WooCommerce Store
Selling to a specific audience? Our plugin lets you password protect WooCommerce products or the entire shop:

  • Preview stores for clients before launch
  • Sell to wholesalers or invite-only customers
  • Hide sensitive or exclusive product listings

Keep your WooCommerce store protected while keeping the design professional.

🔍 SEO Optimized and Fast
This plugin won’t slow down your site. It’s lightweight, SEO-friendly, and works with any theme. Whether you’re running a blog, store, portfolio, or membership site – this plugin ensures your content stays secure and looks great doing it.

💡 Use Cases

  • Protected WordPress site for staging or internal use
  • Password protected WooCommerce catalog for private buyers
  • Exclusive blogs or media libraries
  • Internal company portals

🛠 Compatible With
✅ All major WordPress themes
✅ WooCommerce
✅ Page builders like Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery
✅ Multisite compatible
✅ WPML ready
sections.installation:
Extract the ZIP file.

Upload the extracted folder to the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.

Loook for “Password Protected” menu on WordPress admin dashboard
